dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,6)>Art is hunger, and hunger is art...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,6)>A arte é fome, e a fome é arte...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>From an empty stomach springs boundless creativity! No
muse inspires like the rumble of a tummy!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>De um estômago vazio molas ilimitada criatividade! Não
a musa inspira como o barulho de uma barriga!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,1)>Be that as it may... I’m a little too hungry for my liking.
<$motion(1,669)><$comeff(1,7)><$voicel(1,4)>In fact, this is no time for art at all! Even I, the great
<$cdef(27)>Smearguru, must eat to produce a masterpiece!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,1)>Seja como for... Estou um pouco faminto demais para o meu gosto.
<$motion(1,669)><$comeff(1,7)><$voicel(1,4)>Na verdade, este não é o momento para a arte em tudo!
<$cdef(27)>Smearguru, deve comer para produzir uma obra-prima!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>You there, won’t you help a poor, starving artist? All I ask
for is a simple <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>Você lá, você não vai ajudar um pobre, artista faminto? Tudo o que eu peço
para é um simples <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>Won’t you bring me a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(2340)></color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>Você não vai me trazer um <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(2340)></color>?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh my, what a ripe, juicy-looking <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>! And
that color... Red as the burning flames of inspiration...
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>Why, merely gazing upon it sets my withered heart ablaze!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Meu Deus, que maduro e suculento! <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>E...
aquela cor... vermelha como as chamas ardentes da inspiração...
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>Ora, apenas olhar para ele deixa meu coração murcho em chamas!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>AHAHA! Yes, yesss, I’ve come up with a brilliant idea!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>AHAHA! Sim, sim, sim, eu vim com uma idéia brilhante!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>Hold on to that <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(2340)></color> for now, my friend!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>Segura-te a isso. <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(2340)></color> Por agora, meu amigo!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>Thanks again for showing me that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>. It
gave me a breakthrough!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>Obrigado novamente por me mostrares isso. <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>. Ele
Deu-me um avanço!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>That reddish hue! That brilliant sheen! Surely the only way
to make a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)> shine brighter <$voicel(1,10)>is to smash it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Aquele tom avermelhado, esse brilho brilhante, certamente o único caminho.
para fazer uma <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)> brilho mais brilhante <$voicel(1,10)>É esmagá-lo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>That’ll surely bring out its sweet, sweet artistic potential
and satiate my hunger for knowledge! And food. Heh.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Isso certamente trará à tona seu doce, doce potencial artístico
e saciar a minha fome de conhecimento e comida.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,10)>Wh-what is this?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,10)>O que é isto?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,5)>All I wanted was to savor the sweetness of a smashed-up
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>... <$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,4)>Such a sumptuous-sounding snack...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,5)>Tudo o que eu queria era saborear a doçura de um esmagado
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>... <$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,4)>Um lanche tão suntuosa...

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,826)><$voicel(1,1)>To think it would turn into PAINT instead! Oh,
sweet tragedy...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,826)><$voicel(1,1)>Pensar que se transformaria em tinta em vez disso!
Doce tragédia...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>I suppose this is fate telling me to paint more! And paint I
shall! INSPIRATION, THOU ART WITH ME!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Suponho que isto seja o destino a dizer-me para pintar mais!
Inspire, faça arte comigo!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I cast my aching hunger upon the wind! My brush
need only taste the canvas!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu lancei minha fome dolorosa sobre o vento!
Só precisa provar a tela!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>You can’t win against fate... Heh. So be it. I shall use this
to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)> something spectacular!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>Você não pode vencer contra o destino... Heh. Assim seja. Eu vou usar isso
para <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)> Algo espectacular!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>But what canvas is worthy of being <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)>ed by my new
dye-namic muse? Oh, the choices...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Mas que tela é digna de ser <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)>riz pela minha nova
- Musa Námica-tinta?

If you’d like to try it with items around here, the nearby

<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1567)> e <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1327)> são grandes candidatos

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, how I YEARN to<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)>! I’d trade my whole palette

dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, como eu anseio<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)>! Eu trocaria toda a minha paleta

<$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>You can lead me to a house somewhere or just hand me

<$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>pode levar-me a uma casa algures ou apenas entregar-me.

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Blessed be the artist, beloved by the very fates themselves!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Bendito seja o artista, amado pelos próprios destinos!
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,10)>BEM-VINDO — A minha cativante masterpiece!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,17)>Ahhhhhh...<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>The sweet taste of a project most delightful.
If you ever wish to witness another EARTH-SHATTERING
MARVEL... <$voicel(1,10)>Well, you know who to call. Heh.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,17)>Ahhhhhh...<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>O sabor doce de um projeto muito agradável.
Se alguma vez quiser testemunhar outra TERRA-SHATTERING
Marvel... <$voicel(1,10)>Bem, sabe a quem ligar.

dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Não pense que eu não notei, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>.

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m talking about that little twinkle in your eye as you

to

dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Sim, sim, sim, eu vejo através de ti!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Ahaha! No need to restrain yourself... I see the HUNGER in

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Não precisas de te controlar, vejo o Caçador a entrar.

<$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,826)><$voicel(1,7)>Ahhh, what a wonderfully wicked feeling it is, to be the

<$voicel(1,6)>path we call artistry...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,826)><$voicel(1,7)>Ahhh, que sensação maravilhosamente má é, ser o
um para inspirar outro Pokémon para andar o amargo doce
<$voicel(1,6)>caminho que chamamos de arte...

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)>Oh, sorry. Got a little carried away. <$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,2)>First time I’ve ever had
an artist friend, y’know?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)>Desculpa, deixei-me levar. <$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,2)>Primeira vez que eu já tive

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>In any case, from this day onward, you are my disciple,

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Let my genius talent blaze the trail for you! Together we

a <$cdef(27)>fóssil!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Please bring me a <$cdef(27)>fossil</color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Por favor, traga-me um. <$cdef(27)>fóssil</color>!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Hmmm... So this is a <$cdef(27)>fossil</color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Então, isto é... <$cdef(27)>fóssil</color>?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,7)>Ah, I can sense the endless flow of time... An accumulation
of moments <$voicel(1,6)>forming an unbroken line connecting the
past to the present...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,7)>Consigo sentir o fluxo infinito de tempo... uma acumulação.
de momentos <$voicel(1,6)>formando uma linha contínua que liga o
passado até o presente...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Wait, that’s it! Art is the same! Our smaller works—the
mundane accomplishments we amass over the course of
our lives—<$voicel(1,10)>inevitably build into art!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Espere, é isso! Arte é a mesma! Nossas obras menores – o
realizações mundanas que acumulamos ao longo do curso de
as nossas vidas...<$voicel(1,10)>inevitavelmente, construir em arte!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>I might have been putting too much pressure on myself to
create a singular MASTERPIECE. <$voicel(1,6)>First I’d just have to...
And then I’d only need to...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Talvez estivesse a pressionar-me demais.
criar um MASTERPECE singular. <$voicel(1,6)>Primeiro eu só tinha que...
E então eu só precisaria...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,20)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>EUREKA, I HAVE IT! Inspiration courses through my mind!
Nay... Through the very fiber of my being!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,20)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu tenho! Cursos de inspiração através da minha mente!
Não... através da própria fibra do meu ser!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>! Watch closely, my dear
disciple!
It
falls
upon
your
teacher
to
create
art
worthy
of
our studio!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Vê com atenção, minha querida.
Discipulado!
Ele
quedas
sobre
a sua
professor
para
criar
arte
digno
de
O nosso estúdio!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>So patiently you have waited, my dear disciple! From the
ancient <$cdef(27)>fossil have I devised the fresh and new!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Tão pacientemente esperaste, meu caro discípulo!
antigo <$cdef(27)>fóssil Eu criei o novo e fresco!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>So—objects are made up of various small parts, yes? Say
how a chair has legs and a backrest and such...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Então, os objetos são feitos de várias partes pequenas, sim?
Como uma cadeira tem pernas e um encosto e tal...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>By changing the color and pattern of the PART, you can
reinvent the image of the WHOLE, can you not?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Ao alterar a cor e o padrão da PARTE, você pode
reinventar a imagem de todo o mundo, você não pode?!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>AHAHA! Once I come up with an idea, my brush YEARNS
to create it! You MUST let me <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)> something!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Uma vez que eu tenho uma idéia, meu escova anos
Para criá-lo! Você deve me deixar <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)> Alguma coisa!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>You must let me<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)> something! I want to try coloring
individual parts differently!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>tem de me deixar<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)> algo! Eu quero tentar colorir
partes individuais de forma diferente!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, to be burdened with the weight of this prodigious
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)>ing talent...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, para ser sobrecarregado com o peso deste prodigioso
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)>ing Talento...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I could coordinate all the colors together... Or even play
around with different accent colors...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Posso coordenar todas as cores... ou até mesmo jogar.
em volta com cores de sotaque diferentes...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>BEHOLD, BOUNDLESS POTENTIAL! Why, even I am
frightened by my own talent!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Por que, até eu sou
assustado com o meu próprio talento!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,7)>Phew... It’s thanks to you that I made it to this point,
<$cdef(27)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,7)>Ufa... É graças a você que eu fiz isso a este ponto,
<$cdef(27)>.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Together we will sink into the very core of art itself!
Prepare yourself well, my dearest disciple!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Juntos, vamos afundar-nos no próprio núcleo da arte!
Prepara-te bem, meu querido discípulo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,7)>Aha... AHAHAHA! These colors! Simply stunning!
<$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,10)>Yes, this is the beauty—nay, the very ESSENCE of art!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,7)>Aha... AHAHAHA! Estas cores! Simplesmente deslumbrante!
<$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,10)>Sim, esta é a beleza – não, a própria ESSENÇA da arte!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>All right, just a little more... Keep going...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Está bem, só mais um pouco...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Ah... I hunger...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Tenho fome...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,6)>Art is hunger, and hunger is art...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,6)>A arte é fome, e a fome é arte...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>From an empty stomach springs boundless creativity! No
muse inspires like the rumble of a tummy!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>De um estômago vazio molas ilimitada criatividade! Não
a musa inspira como o barulho de uma barriga!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,1)>Be that as it may... I’m a little too hungry for my liking.
<$motion(1,663)><$comeff(1,7)><$voicel(1,4)>In fact, this is no time for art at all! I must eat!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,1)>Seja como for... Estou um pouco faminto demais para o meu gosto.
<$motion(1,663)><$comeff(1,7)><$voicel(1,4)>Na verdade, este não é o momento para arte em tudo! Eu tenho que comer!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>You there, won’t you help a poor, starving artist? All I ask
for is a simple <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,4)><$voicel(1,5)>Você lá, você não vai ajudar um pobre, artista faminto? Tudo o que eu peço
para é um simples <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Hm? Do you already have one to give?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Já tem um para dar?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh my, what a ripe, juicy-looking berry! And that color...
Red as the burning flames of inspiration...
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>Why, merely gazing upon it sets my withered heart ablaze!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Meu Deus, que baga madura e suculenta!
Vermelho como as chamas ardentes da inspiração...
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>Ora, apenas olhar para ele deixa meu coração murcho em chamas!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>AHAHA! Yes, yesss, I’ve come up with a brilliant idea!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>AHAHA! Sim, sim, sim, eu vim com uma idéia brilhante!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>Hold on to that <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(2340)></color> for now, my friend!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>Segura-te a isso. <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(2340)></color> Por agora, meu amigo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Heh. The master can’t be outdone by the student, you
know? Behold my glorious new <$cdef(27)><$voicel(1,6)><$spwfull(21)>ing technique!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Heh. O mestre não pode ser superado pelo estudante, você
Sabe? Contemple meu glorioso novo <$cdef(27)><$voicel(1,6)><$spwfull(21)>ing Técnica!

dialogues.en: <$cdef(27)>Smearguru </color>can now <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)></color> patterns!
dialogues.pt_br: <$cdef(27)>Smearguru </color>agora pode <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(21)></color> Padrões!
